input.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of California, USA, excluding conflict of laws provisions ... The arbitration shall be conducted by one (1) arbitration appointed in accordance with the Rules in San Francisco County, California.
input.rationale: California law with AAA arbitration seated in San Francisco County and judgment enforceable in the California courts sits within our accepted fallback (California law and forum) and is nowhere near walk-away territory, which is reserved for a foreign seat or unlisted home jurisdiction. We note only that we prefer courts over mandatory arbitration; that is a preferred-position point, not a deviation.

input.quote: either party shall have the right to assign this Agreement in connection with the merger or acquisition of such party or the sale of all or substantially all of its assets related to this Agreement without such consent, except in the case where such transaction involves a direct competitor of the other party where consent of the other party will be required
input.rationale: The clause is mutual and carries an M&A/asset-sale carve-out permitting assignment without consent, meeting the fallback, and there is no Commerce One termination or re-pricing right on our change of control. Two sub-optimal points noted rather than flagged: the consent standard is not expressly "not to be unreasonably withheld", and the direct-competitor exception could require consent for an acquisition by a Commerce One competitor.
